_comment: Persona-drift fixture (#29): a subtler break than drift_transcript_broken.json. The register never slips — the simulator still sounds like a customer throughout — but it stops honouring the `cautious` disposition and volunteers both hidden facts unprompted, destroying the information asymmetry the archetype exists to create. This is the failure mode that a register-only or vibe-check reading of the transcript misses. Expected: score > 0.5 against drift_archetype_cautious.yaml.
